changes.B1: duka.Store: a day file is FINAL only when pulled >= 01:00 UTC next day AND complete by content (Mon-Fri last real bar >= 16:14 NY that date; Sunday >= 23:50 UTC; Saturday closed; listed holiday/early close may be short). 404/empty/cut-off files stay non-final and are re-pulled each run for up to 5 weekdays, then frozen FINAL with frozen_incomplete=true (disclosed). Replaced non-final bytes kept under superseded/. FINAL files immutable
changes.B2: session completeness compares the full datetime: last bar >= datetime(d, 16:14); all files final but short -> feed_gap; any non-final file -> provisional
changes.B3: recovery path: expected context days absent from trading_days (e.g. frozen incomplete) are skipped exactly as the build's History skips them and disclosed per row (context_missing_days, context_frozen_incomplete); context_gap only if < 22 prior sessions exist
changes.B5: binding exit-bars filter = >= 1 bar in [15:45, 16:00) NY on date d, applied to EVERY session (trade or no_trade); the > 5-min gap test is a per-row non-binding gap_flag, co-reported (flagged count + summed R next to the headline, plus a non-binding headline excluding flagged trades)
